notes.title: v0.5.1
notes.content:
Fixes:


 Fixed bug preventing players from crushing spawning greebles while possessing a fireball special.
 Fixed bug allowing immovable blocks to be crushed.
 Fixed bug allowing blocks spawning greebles to be pushed.


As always, bug reports or reporting differences from the original are welcome! Please report them using this form, or by opening an issue on GitHub.
